string_var refId
int op
float height
float speed
float offsetX
float offsetY
ref item
float x
float y
float z
float result
float hx
float hy
float hz
begin function {refId,op,height,speed,offsetX,offsetY}
if op == 0
let item := player.PlaceAtMe WhiskeyBottle01Empty01 1
let x := player.GetPos X
let y := player.GetPos Y
let z := player.GetPos Z
let x += offsetX
let y += offsetY
let z += 1000
let hz := z - 2000
let result := GetP2PRayCastRange x y z x y hz 6
let z := hz + result + height
item.SetPosEx x y z
SetFunctionValue item
elseif op == 3
let item := player.PlaceAtMe SignStop01 1
let x := player.GetPos X
let y := player.GetPos Y
let z := player.GetPos Z
let x += offsetX
let y += offsetY
let z += 150
let hz := z - 1000
let result := GetP2PRayCastRange x y z x y hz 6
let z := hz + result + height
item.SetPosEx x y z
item.SetAngle X 0
item.SetAngle Y 0
item.SetAngle Z speed
SetFunctionValue item
elseif op == 1
let item := StringToRef "$refId"
let result := 1
SetFunctionValue result
elseif op == 2
let item := StringToRef "$refId"
item.Disable
item.MarkForDelete
SetFunctionValue 1
endif
end
